title: Emit only JSON-LD Person; do not add BreadcrumbList or WebSite+SearchAction
body: BreadcrumbList describes a navigation hierarchy and the landing is one page with none; WebSite+SearchAction declares an internal search that does not exist. Structured data describing something absent is worse than none — Google flags it as inconsistent. src/lib/jsonld.ts emits Person only. Reconsider BreadcrumbList when case studies become pages of their own.
not_derivable: The rejected schema.org types and the trigger to reconsider are not in code.

evidence.summary: ContentView -> schema.org Person, the only type emitted.
